rubrics.justification: Describes the embryo as a good-quality expanded blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, intact zona, and no obvious degeneration; appropriately notes limits of single-frame assessment. Minor inconsistency between calling it 3AA and suggesting it may be closer to early expanded stage.
Strongly integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor, sperm motility, BMI, smoking, prior failed cycle, and thin endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-supported, with prognosis adjusted for favorable embryo quality and adverse uterine/lifestyle factors. Some mild inconsistency from multiple probability ranges and speculative comments about euploid rates.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading and evidence-based IVF counseling, including concern for thin lining, smoking cessation, avoiding bed rest, and selective further workup. Slight overreach in discussing cotinine testing and some speculative statements about sperm DNA effects.
Provides practical next steps for transfer optimization, lifestyle modification, cavity/endometrial review, and future-cycle evaluation. Useful and specific, though not highly protocol-detailed.
